title: Harness inference-profile revision edit
description: The admitted edit route `POST /v1/inference-profiles/{profile_id}/revisions`. The request restates only the fields an owner publishes as editable — version, prompt revision, settings revision, supported settings and effective budgets — and carries a compare-and-swap expectation plus a caller mutation identity. There is deliberately no field that could carry a credential, endpoint, executable or tool authority, and no field that could restate adapter, model identity, node kinds, operations, context compatibility, continuity, state or grants: a consumer edit inherits every identity and authority field from the revision it edits, so it cannot widen a profile. The response names the adopted revision as the exact `profile_id:version:digest` reference a new definition pins; its `revision` member is an `ascension.inference-profile/v1` descriptor whose closed shape is defined by `catalog.schema.json#/$defs/descriptor`.

request.description: Closed: any field outside the editable allow-list is rejected rather than ignored, so an unadvertised authority or credential field cannot be smuggled through an edit that is otherwise well-formed.

expected_revision_digest.description: The compare-and-swap expectation: the exact digest of the served revision this edit was authored against. The swap is won only if the accepted head still carries it.

client_mutation_id.description: Stable caller identity, so a retried edit is replayed rather than applied twice.

version.description: The new revision identity. It must differ from the edited revision, because a revision is keyed by profile_id and version.

outcome.description: `adopted` won the swap, `replayed` found this client_mutation_id already applied with the same candidate, and `conflict` lost the swap to a concurrent edit.

reference.description: `profile_id:version:digest` of `revision`, the exact reference a new definition pins. On a conflict this names the revision that won.

revision.description: The adopted revision, or the currently accepted revision when the swap was lost. Its closed descriptor shape is `catalog.schema.json#/$defs/descriptor`.
